item.title: Fusion Music
item.author: highestpeakpublic@gmail.com (Highestpeak)
item.description: Fusion Music is a real-time collaborative music editing platform that combines domain-driven design with modern full-stack technologies to deliver an intuitive and efficient music creation experience. This article provides an in-depth overview of the project’s design principles, system architecture, core features, testing strategies, and deployment approach, while outlining future enhancements.
